featured_reviews.name: Yogesh Kamat
featured_reviews.review_text: Nothing much to add about DMart than what people already know. This one at Goregaon West, Link Road is huge, with big aisles which have loads of products well segmented. Staff is knowledgeable & friendly. Check out counters are plenty though I wish they have more Express check out counters at peak hours.

featured_reviews.name: Faizal Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
visited the D Mart and was impressed with the range of products available at very affordable prices. The mall offers a wide selection of goods, from clothing and accessories to household items and electronics, all at very cheap prices. Additionally, there are frequent discounts and sales, making it an excellent choice for those looking for a bargain.

The mall is conveniently located and easily accessible by public transportation, making it a convenient choice for those who prefer not to drive.

One thing to note is that the mall is often crowded, particularly during peak hours, but this is to be expected given the affordable prices and great selection of products. Despite this, the mall is well-organized and the staff are friendly and helpful, making the shopping experience enjoyable.

Overall, I would highly recommend D Mart Mall to anyone looking for a great shopping experience at an affordable price. This mall is particularly well-suited for the middle class, as it offers great value for money without compromising on quality. So, if you're looking for great discounts and don't mind crowds, D Mart is the place for you!

featured_reviews.name: Shabeer Mohamedappa
featured_reviews.review_text: It's an amazing supermarket in Mumbai. I prefer shopping at the Bangur Nagar Dmart coz it is spacious and provides ample breathing room for customers. The store offers great deals and discounts, which makes it very crowded, so it's best to avoid visiting on weekends/holidays. They provide a massive free parking space for Dmart customers. Their prices for groceries, staples, and daily essential household items are unmatched in the market. The staff are helpful and polite. The store also has a small bakery where u can buy sweets, farsan, popcorn, and ice cream. Overall, we are very satisfied with the offers, great discounts, & the quality of items.

featured_reviews.name: Raj Gvalani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very Big Spacious two levels of shopping. You find almost everything that you need. From shoes to clothing, all groceries, kitchen wares, kitchen tools, home decor, fans, lighting, etc.

All these goods very reasonably priced maybe not the best prices in town. But definitely the services are good. This is definitely my first choice for shopping, In store or online .

featured_reviews.name: SRP
featured_reviews.review_text:
My first time in an Indian supermarket and I was blown away with the choices, variety and the prices.

The family had to shop for a huge event ne it made sense to do a large purchasing from here.

As the roads were under construction near parking area, we could not find a way to get into official parking area and no signs as well from DMart as to how to get to the parking.

The inside is fairly clean and well stocked. Ok the advertised products were in stock. The prices to me were incredibly well priced. All the regular prices are discounted from the MSRP.

The clothes section is not as attractive for us. But the grocery items are superb.

featured_reviews.name: Shahana Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an excellent experience at the DMart store located in Bangur Nagar, Goregaon, thanks to Harshad. I was looking for a specific check-in bag, which unfortunately was not available at that time. However, Harshad went above and beyond to help me.

He took extra initiative, made special efforts, and managed to arrange the bag for me on the very same day, which I was told wasn’t possible. Because of his dedication and commitment, I was able to get my desired brand bag and fly on time without any inconvenience.

I truly appreciate his outstanding customer service, positive attitude, and willingness to help. Employees like Harshad make a huge difference and create a memorable shopping experience.

Thank you, Harshad, and keep up the amazing work!

featured_reviews.name: Dev Devoy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Overall, I had a good shopping experience, and the prices are quite reasonable compared to other nearby stores such as Reliance Smart Bazaar. However, there are a few ongoing issues that need attention.
Many essential products are frequently out of stock. Instead of informing customers about upcoming deliveries, the staff simply states that the items are unavailable.
Additionally, the billing counters often have long queues. Even when purchasing a small number of items around 10 products the waiting time can range from 10 to 40 minutes, which is inconvenient.

featured_reviews.name: jameer pathan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Today I visited to buy clothes for my kids, but unfortunately, the selection was quite limited and I ended up leaving empty hands.

However, I must say that the store is spacious and well organized and they have an impressive food section with a wide range of products.

Overall, it's a good place to visit, but they could work on improving their kids clothing range.
